name: garmin-learning
description: Independent JSON tools for Garmin health datasets and workout types, with local coaching analysis and dashboards.

interface.longDescription: Read supported Garmin Personal API data, analyze health and training trends, keep a local gym journal, and generate dashboard snapshots. Requires this Mac and the existing Python environment.
interface.defaultPrompt: 列出 Garmin Learning 可读取的数据类型，然后根据我指定的日期分析睡眠和训练。
